QuestInfo.name: Foreign World
QuestInfo.0: Those #o0210100#s were too weak. Maybe you were sleeping longer than you thought... You need to find out what else has changed.
QuestInfo.1: The forest has changed. Things seem more peaceful, and there are signs of civilization here and there. If you follow these signs, the bridges, the buildings, perhaps you can #bfind a town#b.
QuestInfo.2: You'd never seen buildings like that before. It seemed like the Elves' town, but its people were no Elves you'd ever seen. The name of the town seemed to be #m101000000#.

0.0: How much time has passed, anyway? How many years would it take for the #o0210100#s to get so weak? And what became of the Black Mage? I need answers!
0.1: The only way I'll get any answers is by #bleaving town#k.

yes.0: All right, time to venture out into the world. It'll be nice to see someone who ISN'T trapped in a big ice cube!

no.0: I'm still the sovereign of the Elves. I should make sure I'm nice and composed before I go to greet the outside world.

1.0: Didn't this used to be the forest of the fairies? These trees weren't here before...and neither were those houses! A huge town like this couldn't pop up in just a couple years. Just how long was I asleep?

default.0: I've got to be careful. If I get lost, I may never find my way back home...or I might run into a monster I'm not ready for. Let's just...observe for now. Signs...wooden bridges... All man-made...
